zh.purpose: 解析一个 XACP/1 帧的纯 XUN 正文。传输层已去掉 XACP/1\n<N>\n 长度前缀并读取恰好 N 字节；本函数只接收正文。空正文、超过 MAX_FRAME_BYTES 或非法 XUN 时抛出错误。

params.src: 传输层解码后的纯 XUN 正文，不含长度前缀

zh.returns: 解析后的 XUN 文档；请求 schema 由 validate_request 另行校验

en.purpose: Parse the plain XUN body of one XACP/1 frame. The transport has already stripped the XACP/1\n<N>\n length prefix and read exactly N bytes; pass only the body. Throws for an empty body, a body above MAX_FRAME_BYTES, or invalid XUN.

params.src: plain XUN body after transport decoding, without the length prefix

en.returns: parsed XUN document; validate_request checks the request schema separately

zh.purpose: 完整控件主题；文本缩放与几何密度独立。通过工厂构造后修改，并调用 validate。

params.font: global font for controls with inherit_font=true
params.density: geometry scale, 0.5–4.0; does not scale text
params.background: View background; must be opaque when presenting

zh.purpose: 字体配置；空 family 使用系统字体，size 与 line_height 使用逻辑像素。

params.family: UTF-8 family, at most 256 bytes without NUL; empty selects system font
params.size: base size, 1–512; scaled size must remain in range
params.line_height: 0 selects default; explicit value must be at least size and at most 1024

zh.purpose: 控件颜色、字体和几何样式。指标为非负有限值；偏移允许负数。用 clone 深复制规则数组。

params.inherit_font: true 继承 Styles.font；false 使用本控件 font

params.icon_size: 图片图标方形边长；0 不留图标间距
params.states: 最多 32 条规则；后匹配的字段覆盖先匹配值

en.purpose: Control colors, typography and geometry. Metrics are finite and nonnegative; offsets may be negative. clone deep-copies the rule array.

params.inherit_font: true inherits Styles.font; false uses the local font
params.min_height: minimum logical height; minimum thumb length for Scroll
params.gap: spacing between text, icons or indicators
params.indicator_size: checkbox indicator size or scrollbar thickness
params.shadow_blur: blur radius for the at-most-eight-layer approximation
params.icon_size: image icon square size; 0 removes icon spacing
params.states: up to 32 rules; later matching field overrides win

zh.purpose: 组合状态的选择性覆盖；全部 when 位匹配且没有 unless 位时生效。按数组顺序应用，后匹配规则胜出。

params.when: 必须全部存在的状态位，0–127
params.unless: 任一出现便排除的状态位；不能与 when 重叠
params.fields: paint_* 位掩码，0–255；只覆盖声明的字段

en.purpose: Selective combined-state override. Matches all when bits and no unless bits; rules apply in array order, with later overrides winning.

params.unless: excluded state bits; cannot overlap when
params.fields: paint_* mask, 0–255; only selected fields change

zh.purpose: 基础状态调色板；背景优先级：禁用、错误、只读、选中、按下、悬停、普通。

params.accent: 选中背景及进度指示条
params.invalid: 错误边框及错误进度条

en.purpose: Base state palette. Background precedence: disabled, invalid, read-only, selected, pressed, hovered, normal.

zh.purpose: 拥有文字与原生排版缓存的标签；改色复用排版，字体变化重新排版，用完 dispose。

en.purpose: Owned text and native layout cache. Palette changes reuse layout; font changes rebuild it. Dispose when finished.

zh.purpose: 保留场景的样式感知回调。借用有效主题，绘制坐标为节点局部坐标；回调内不能修改 View 或拓扑。overlay 在子节点之后执行。

en.purpose: Style-aware retained callbacks. Borrow the effective theme and paint in node-local coordinates. Do not mutate View or topology in callbacks. Overlay runs after children.

zh.purpose: 创建完整的深色主题；后续主题切换由应用控制。
zh.returns: 独立 Styles 值

en.purpose: Create a complete dark theme; applications control subsequent switching.
en.returns: an owned Styles value

zh.purpose: 创建完整的浅色主题；后续主题切换由应用控制。

en.purpose: Create a complete light theme; applications control subsequent switching.

zh.returns: 独立 Styles 值

en.purpose: Create a complete high-contrast theme; applications control subsequent switching.
en.returns: an owned Styles value

zh.purpose: 创建 when 规则，初始 fields=0；设置 paint_* 位后相应覆盖才生效。

params.when: 必须匹配的组合状态位

zh.returns: 待配置的规则

en.purpose: Create a rule with when and fields=0. Select paint_* bits to activate the corresponding overrides.
en.returns: a rule ready for customization

zh.purpose: 校验字体、缩放、密度、几何与状态规则；无效值抛出错误。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Validate fonts, text scale, density, geometry and state rules; throws on invalid values.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 深复制主题，包括各控件的状态规则数组。
zh.returns: 独立 Styles

en.purpose: Deep-copy the theme, including each control state-rule array.
en.returns: an owned Styles

zh.purpose: 深复制控件样式及状态规则数组。
zh.returns: 独立 ControlStyle

en.purpose: Deep-copy the control style and state-rule array.
en.returns: an owned ControlStyle

zh.purpose: 比较影响文字与几何测量的字段；颜色与装饰不影响结果。
zh.returns: 测量指标是否相同

en.purpose: Compare fields affecting typography and geometry measurement; colors and decorations are excluded.
en.returns: whether measurement metrics match

zh.purpose: 比较完整主题，含状态规则。
zh.returns: 是否完全相同

en.purpose: Compare the complete theme, including state rules.
en.returns: whether all style fields match

zh.purpose: 按基础调色板与顺序规则解析组合状态，不改变控件。
zh.returns: 已解析的颜色与图标透明度

en.purpose: Resolve combined states using the base palette and ordered rules without mutating the control.
en.returns: resolved colors and icon opacity

zh.purpose: 读取节点继承的完整主题并返回独立克隆。
zh.returns: 独立 Styles；无效节点抛出错误

en.purpose: Return an owned clone of the complete theme inherited by the node.
en.returns: owned Styles; throws for an invalid node

zh.purpose: 设置根主题。颜色变化只重绘；测量指标变化还使已注册节点重新测量，相同值不失效。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Set the root theme. Palette changes repaint; metric changes also remeasure registered nodes. Equal values are a no-op.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 为非根节点保存完整主题快照，后代继承到下一作用域；后续全局变化保留此快照。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Store a complete theme snapshot on a non-root node, inherited until another scope. Later global changes preserve it.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 移除显式局部主题并恢复继承，使受影响缓存失效。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Remove a local theme and restore inheritance, invalidating affected caches.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 选择节点是否使用 StyledPainter.measure_styled；启用时标记需要测量。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Opt a node into StyledPainter.measure_styled; enabling marks measurement dirty.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 文字或固有尺寸改变后调用；标记绘制，并让已注册的节点重新测量。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Call after text or intrinsic size changes; marks paint dirty and remeasures registered nodes.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 切换只读并释放或重启原生输入会话；保留选择、导航、复制，拒绝只读期间的写入与迟到 IME 提交。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Switch read-only state, releasing or restarting native input. Preserve selection, navigation and copy; reject edits and late IME commits while read-only.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 设置画布全局矩形；布局或祖先滚动后更新，以同步原生 IME 几何。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Set canvas-global bounds after layout or ancestor scrolling to synchronize native IME geometry.

en.purpose: Change editing focus and native session lifetime; committed text persists on blur.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 返回按内容长度、偏移和最小滑块尺寸计算的矩形。

en.purpose: Return the thumb rectangle from content extent, offset and minimum thumb size.
en.returns: thumb in control coordinates

zh.purpose: 绘制滚动条并清除其脏标记；在 overlay_styled 中于子内容之后调用。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Paint the scrollbar and clear its dirty flag. Call after child content in overlay_styled.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 按样式绘制图片图标和标签；图像保持纵横比，调用者拥有 Image。
zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Paint an image icon and label using styles. The icon preserves aspect ratio; the caller owns the Image.
en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

zh.purpose: 测量图标、标签、间距与内边距；icon_size=0 时不保留图标间距。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸

en.purpose: Measure the icon, label, gap and padding. icon_size=0 removes icon spacing.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size

zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.purpose: Paint Editor using the complete theme; control bounds and Frame use the same local coordinates.

zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Button with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量Checkbox。
zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Checkbox with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.
en.returns: intrinsic logical size; throws if native shaping fails

zh.returns: 固有逻辑尺寸；原生排版失败时抛出错误

en.purpose: Measure Editor with the effective font, density, content and minimum size.

zh.purpose: 按有效字体、密度、内容和最小尺寸测量StyledLabel。

zh.returns: 成功为 0；失败抛出错误

en.returns: 0 on success; throws on failure

params.modifiers: modifier mask; menu_primary selects Cmd / Ctrl

params.current: whether this is the current window screen

params.timeout_ms: 毫秒期限；0 选择默认值

zh.purpose: 创建没有截止时间、不会自动取消的基础上下文，作为独立任务的起点。
zh.returns: 新的 `Context`；`deadline_ns` 为 `0`，键值为空，`done` 等待取消。

en.purpose: Create an independent context with no deadline or automatic cancellation.
en.returns: A new `Context` with deadline `0`, no values and an open `done` channel.

zh.purpose: 创建可以主动取消的独立上下文；保留返回的控制句柄，在任务结束或需要中止时调用 `cancel`。
zh.returns: 包含上下文 `ctx` 和取消能力的 `Cancel`；不接收或继承父上下文。

en.purpose: Create an independent, manually cancellable context; retain the handle to cancel it when the task ends.
en.returns: A `Cancel` containing `ctx` and cancellation control; it takes no parent context.

zh.purpose: 发出取消信号，关闭此句柄的 `ctx.done`，让等待该通道的任务结束等待。
zh.returns: 不返回值；重复调用不会重复关闭通道。

en.purpose: Signal cancellation by closing this handle's `ctx.done`, releasing tasks waiting on that channel.
en.returns: No return value; repeated calls do not close the channel twice.

zh.purpose: 从父上下文派生可取消的子任务；父任务取消时会把取消信号传给子任务。

params.parent: 父上下文；复制其字符串键值和截止时间，并监听它的取消通道。

zh.returns: 控制子上下文的 `Cancel`。主动取消子任务不会取消父任务。

en.purpose: Derive a cancellable child whose cancellation follows its parent.

params.parent: Parent context; its string values and deadline are copied, and its cancellation channel is observed.

en.returns: A `Cancel` controlling the child. Cancelling the child does not cancel its parent.

zh.purpose: 创建在指定时长后自动取消的独立上下文，也可在超时前主动取消。

params.timeout_ns: 从现在开始等待的纳秒数；`1_000_000_000` 表示一秒，负数按 `0` 处理。

zh.returns: 包含截止时间和取消句柄的 `Cancel`。
notes: 超时信号由协程发送；时长为 `0` 不表示返回时通道一定已经关闭。

en.purpose: Create an independent context that cancels after a duration, or earlier through its cancel handle.

params.timeout_ns: Duration from now in nanoseconds; `1_000_000_000` is one second. Negative durations are treated as zero.

en.returns: A `Cancel` containing the deadline and cancellation handle.
notes: A coroutine sends the timeout signal; a zero duration does not guarantee that the channel is already closed on return.

zh.purpose: 创建到指定绝对时间后自动取消的独立上下文。

params.deadline_ns: 与 `now_ns()` 使用相同时间基准的绝对纳秒时间；不是从现在起等待的时长。

zh.returns: 带此截止时间的 `Cancel`；过去的时间会安排立即取消。

en.purpose: Create an independent context that cancels at an absolute deadline.

params.deadline_ns: Absolute nanosecond timestamp using the same clock as `now_ns()`, not a duration from now.

en.returns: A `Cancel` with this deadline; a past timestamp schedules immediate cancellation.

zh.purpose: 读取此上下文保存的截止时间，不等待超时，也不改变取消状态。
zh.returns: 绝对纳秒时间；`background` 或 `without_cancel` 上下文返回 `0`。

en.purpose: Read the stored deadline without waiting or changing cancellation state.
en.returns: Absolute nanosecond deadline, or `0` for a `background` or `without_cancel` context.

zh.purpose: 检查上下文是否已经取消或超时；通过正常返回或抛错让调用方决定是否继续工作。
zh.returns: 仍有效时返回 `0`；取消或超时时抛错，不以返回码表示原因。
errors: 取消时抛出 `context canceled`；截止时间已到时抛出 `context deadline exceeded`。

en.purpose: Check cancellation and expiry, returning normally only while work may continue.
en.returns: Returns `0` while active; cancellation and expiry throw instead of returning a status code.
errors: Throws `context canceled` on cancellation or `context deadline exceeded` after the deadline.

zh.purpose: 为上下文附加一个字符串键值，适合向子调用传递请求标识等轻量信息。

params.parent: 继承其取消通道、截止时间和已有键值；本调用不修改父上下文。
params.key: 区分大小写的字符串键；同名键的新值覆盖查找结果。

zh.returns: 包含新增键值的新 `Context`，与父上下文共享取消信号。

en.purpose: Attach a string key-value pair, such as a request identifier, for downstream calls.

params.parent: Parent whose cancellation channel, deadline and existing values are inherited without modifying it.
params.key: Case-sensitive string key; a newer value shadows an existing key.

en.returns: A new `Context` with the added value and shared parent cancellation.

zh.purpose: 读取上下文中指定键的字符串值；有多次同名设置时取最近添加的一次。

params.key: 要查找的完整键名，区分大小写。

zh.returns: 找到的字符串；已存储的空字符串也正常返回。
errors: 键不存在时抛出 `context: no value`；需要区分缺失值与空值时应处理此错误。

examples.title: 区分缺少键和正常取值

en.purpose: Read a string value, choosing the most recently added value for a repeated key.
en.returns: Stored string, including a legitimately empty string.
errors: A missing key throws `context: no value`; handle this to distinguish absence from an empty value.

examples.title: Read a value and handle a missing key

zh.purpose: 复制上下文中的字符串键值，创建可以独立于父任务取消和超时继续工作的上下文。

params.parent: 只复制键值；其取消通道和截止时间不会传给结果。

zh.returns: 新的 `Context`，截止时间为 `0`，具有独立的取消通道。

en.purpose: Copy string values into a context independent of its parent's cancellation and deadline.

params.parent: Source of values; its cancellation channel and deadline are not carried into the result.

en.returns: A new `Context` with deadline `0` and an independent open cancellation channel.

zh.purpose: 读取供用户或日志查看的错误消息。本调用只返回保存的文本。
zh.returns: 错误消息字符串。

en.purpose: Read the error message for display or logging. This returns the stored text.
en.returns: The error message.

zh.purpose: 读取供用户或日志查看的错误消息。本调用只返回保存的文本。
zh.returns: 错误消息字符串。数值错误码不会自动加入文本。

en.purpose: Read the error message for display or logging. This returns the stored text.
en.returns: The error message. The numeric code is not added automatically.

zh.purpose: 读取供用户或日志查看的错误消息。包装错误会用 `: ` 连接上下文和原消息。
zh.returns: 错误消息字符串。

en.purpose: Read the error message for display or logging. Wrapped messages join context and cause with `: `.
en.returns: The error message.

zh.purpose: 用一段可读文字创建错误值，供调用方返回、包装或抛出。创建本身不会抛错。
zh.returns: 保存该文本的 `StrErr`。

en.purpose: Create an error value from readable text for returning, wrapping or throwing; constructing it does not throw.
en.returns: A `StrErr` storing the text.

zh.purpose: 创建同时携带数值代码和消息的错误值，便于程序分类和用户阅读。

params.code: 调用方定义的错误代码；本函数不校验或映射代码含义。
params.text: 可读错误消息；`msg()` 返回它，不会自动拼接代码。

zh.returns: 包含 `code` 和 `text` 的 `CodeErr`。

en.purpose: Create an error with a numeric code for classification and a message for display.

params.code: Caller-defined error code; this function does not validate or map it.
params.text: Readable message returned by `msg()` without automatically including the code.

en.returns: A `CodeErr` containing `code` and `text`.

zh.purpose: 在已有错误前补充当前操作的背景，例如说明是读取哪个文件时失败。

params.err: 原错误的 `Error` 值；保存的是调用时的消息文本。

zh.returns: `WrapErr`；`msg()` 按 `text + ": " + cause` 生成消息。
notes: 包装保存消息文本；之后不能从中取回原错误的具体类型或数值代码。

examples.title: 为底层错误补充上下文
examples.output:
read config: not found
not found
true

en.purpose: Add operation context to an existing error, for example which file could not be read.

params.err: Original `Error`; its message text is captured at this call.

en.returns: A `WrapErr` whose `msg()` combines `text + ": " + cause`.
notes: Wrapping retains the message text; the original concrete error type and numeric code cannot be recovered from it.

examples.title: Add context to an underlying error
examples.output:
read config: not found
not found
true

zh.purpose: 读取包装时保存的原错误消息，适合单独展示底层原因。
zh.returns: 保存的原因字符串；类型为 `string`，不是 `Error` 对象。

en.purpose: Read the original message captured when the error was wrapped.
en.returns: The captured cause as a `string`, not an `Error` object.

zh.purpose: 按消息匹配目标错误，也能识别以 `: ` 包装的消息后缀。
zh.returns: 消息完全相同，或原消息以 `": " + target.msg()` 结尾时为 `true`。
notes: 比较依据是消息文本；相同消息的不同错误对象也会匹配。

en.purpose: Match a target error message, including a suffix wrapped with `: `.
en.returns: `true` when messages match exactly or the error ends in `": " + target.msg()`.
notes: Comparison uses message text, so distinct error objects with the same message also match.

zh.purpose: 把两个错误的消息合成一段，适合汇总两项操作的失败原因。
zh.returns: 包含合并消息的 `StrErr`；两段非空消息之间插入换行，空消息直接省略。

en.purpose: Combine two error messages, for example to report failures from two operations.
en.returns: A `StrErr` joining nonempty messages with a newline and omitting empty messages.

zh.purpose: 从错误消息中取最后一个 `: ` 后面的文本，适合读取最内层的消息片段。
zh.returns: 最后一个分隔符之后的字符串；没有 `: ` 时返回空字符串。
notes: 它按文本分隔符处理消息，返回字符串；消息本身含 `: ` 时也会被拆分。

en.purpose: Extract text after the final `: ` in an error message.
en.returns: Text after the final separator, or an empty string when there is no `: `.
notes: This returns a string by splitting message text; a literal `: ` inside a message is also treated as a separator.

zh.purpose: 把十进制数字文本转换为整数，适合读取配置或解析用户输入。

params.s: 要转换的完整数字文本；不会自动去掉空白或进制前缀。

zh.returns: 解析出的整数；支持的数值范围受 `int` 限制。
notes: 只接受数字和可选的前导负号；不接受前导 `+`、空白或 `0x` 前缀。
errors: 不支持的进制抛出 `strconv: unsupported base`；非法数字或越界也会抛错，应处理或继续传播。

en.purpose: Convert decimal numeric text to an integer, for configuration or user input.

params.s: Complete numeric text; whitespace and base prefixes are not removed.

en.returns: The parsed integer, within the range of `int`.
notes: Accepts digits with an optional leading minus; no leading `+`, whitespace or `0x` prefix.
errors: An unsupported base throws `strconv: unsupported base`; invalid or out-of-range input also throws and must be handled or propagated.

zh.purpose: 把指定进制的数字文本转换为整数，适合读取配置或解析用户输入。

params.s: 要转换的完整数字文本；不会自动去掉空白或进制前缀。
params.base: 进制，只支持 `2`、`8`、`10`、`16`；不会根据 `0x` 等前缀自动推断。

zh.returns: 解析出的整数；支持的数值范围受 `int` 限制。
notes: 只接受数字和可选的前导负号；不接受前导 `+`、空白或 `0x` 前缀。
errors: 不支持的进制抛出 `strconv: unsupported base`；非法数字或越界也会抛错，应处理或继续传播。

examples.title: 显式指定进制并处理错误

params.base: Base: only `2`, `8`, `10` and `16` are supported; prefixes such as `0x` do not select it automatically.

en.returns: The parsed integer, within the range of `int`.
notes: Accepts digits with an optional leading minus; no leading `+`, whitespace or `0x` prefix.
errors: An unsupported base throws `strconv: unsupported base`; invalid or out-of-range input also throws and must be handled or propagated.

notes: 只接受非负整数；以 `int` 返回，因此不能表示超出有符号 `int` 上限的数值。

params.s: Complete numeric text; whitespace and base prefixes are not removed.
params.base: Base: only `2`, `8`, `10` and `16` are supported; prefixes such as `0x` do not select it automatically.

errors: An unsupported base throws `strconv: unsupported base`; invalid or out-of-range input also throws and must be handled or propagated.

zh.purpose: 把整数转换成十进制文本，适合输出或拼接消息。
zh.returns: 数字字符串；十六进制使用小写字母，不自动添加进制前缀。

en.purpose: Format an integer as decimal text for output or messages.
en.returns: Numeric string; hexadecimal uses lowercase letters without an automatic base prefix.

zh.purpose: 把整数转换成指定进制的文本，适合输出或拼接消息。

params.base: 进制，只支持 `2`、`8`、`10`、`16`；不会根据 `0x` 等前缀自动推断。

zh.returns: 数字字符串；十六进制使用小写字母，不自动添加进制前缀。
errors: 进制不受支持时抛错。

en.purpose: Format an integer as explicit-base text for output or messages.

params.base: Base: only `2`, `8`, `10` and `16` are supported; prefixes such as `0x` do not select it automatically.

en.returns: Numeric string; hexadecimal uses lowercase letters without an automatic base prefix.
errors: An unsupported base throws.

zh.purpose: 把整数转换成指定进制的文本，适合输出或拼接消息。

params.base: 进制，只支持 `2`、`8`、`10`、`16`；不会根据 `0x` 等前缀自动推断。

zh.returns: 数字字符串；十六进制使用小写字母，不自动添加进制前缀。
errors: 负数抛出 `strconv: unsigned of negative`，不支持的进制也会抛错。

en.purpose: Format an integer as explicit-base text for output or messages.

params.base: Base: only `2`, `8`, `10` and `16` are supported; prefixes such as `0x` do not select it automatically.

en.returns: Numeric string; hexadecimal uses lowercase letters without an automatic base prefix.
errors: Negative input throws `strconv: unsigned of negative`; an unsupported base also throws.

zh.purpose: 把常见布尔文本转换为 `bool`，适合读取环境变量和配置开关。

params.s: 完整输入文本；不会自动去掉空白。

zh.returns: `1`、`t`、`T`、`true`、`TRUE`、`True` 得到 `true`；`0`、`f`、`F`、`false`、`FALSE`、`False` 得到 `false`。
errors: 其他拼写（包括混合大小写或带空白的文本）抛出 `strconv: invalid bool`。

en.purpose: Parse common boolean text for environment variables and configuration switches.

params.s: Complete input text; whitespace is not trimmed.

en.returns: `1`, `t`, `T`, `true`, `TRUE` and `True` yield `true`; `0`, `f`, `F`, `false`, `FALSE` and `False` yield `false`.
errors: Other spellings, including mixed case or surrounding whitespace, throw `strconv: invalid bool`.

zh.purpose: 把布尔值写成稳定的小写文本，适合保存配置或拼接消息。
zh.returns: `true` 或 `false` 字符串。

en.purpose: Format a boolean as predictable lowercase text for configuration or messages.
en.returns: The string `true` or `false`.

zh.purpose: 按指定格式和精度把浮点数转换为文本，适合控制显示的小数位数。

params.f: 要转换的浮点数。
params.verb: 格式字符的整数编码：`101`（e）为科学计数法，`102`（f）为定点，`103`（g）自动选择紧凑形式。
params.prec: e/f 格式的小数位数，g 格式的有效数字数；负数选择可还原原值的最短表示，g 的 `0` 按 `1` 处理。

zh.returns: 格式化结果；特殊值分别写成 `NaN`、`+Inf`、`-Inf`。
errors: `verb` 不是 `101`、`102` 或 `103` 时抛出 `strconv: unknown format verb`。

en.purpose: Format a floating-point number with an explicit style and precision for display.

params.f: Floating-point value to format.
params.verb: Format character code: `101` (e) for scientific, `102` (f) for fixed-point, or `103` (g) for a compact choice.
params.prec: Decimal places for e/f or significant digits for g; negative selects the shortest round-trippable representation, and g treats `0` as `1`.

en.returns: Formatted text; special values are written as `NaN`, `+Inf` and `-Inf`.
errors: A verb other than `101`, `102` or `103` throws `strconv: unknown format verb`.

zh.purpose: 解析十进制浮点文本，支持小数和科学计数法，适合读取数值输入。

params.s: 完整数字文本，可含正负号；不会自动去除首尾空白。

zh.returns: 解析出的 `f64`；也接受不区分大小写的 `NaN`、`Inf`、`Infinity` 形式。
errors: 空文本、非法格式、未消费完的字符或有限数值溢出会抛错。

en.purpose: Parse decimal floating-point text with optional fractions and exponents.

params.s: Complete numeric text with an optional sign; surrounding whitespace is not trimmed.

en.returns: Parsed `f64`; case-insensitive `NaN`, `Inf` and `Infinity` forms are also accepted.
errors: Empty input, invalid syntax, trailing characters or finite numeric overflow throws.

zh.purpose: 把任意字节文本写成带双引号的转义文本，便于日志中看清换行、引号和不可见字节。

params.s: 要处理的原文本；以只读借用传入，本调用不会修改它。

zh.returns: 带双引号的文本；反斜杠和双引号被转义，非 ASCII 字节使用 `\xHH`。
notes: 非 ASCII 字符按 UTF-8 字节逐个转义；需要按 Unicode 码点输出 `\u`/`\U` 时可使用 `quote_to_ascii`。

examples.title: 转义文本往返还原

en.purpose: Quote byte text with double quotes so logs can show newlines, quotes and invisible bytes.

params.s: Original text, passed as a read-only borrow; this call does not modify it.

en.returns: Double-quoted text, escaping backslashes and double quotes and representing non-ASCII bytes as `\xHH`.
notes: Non-ASCII characters are escaped byte by byte; use `quote_to_ascii` for Unicode code point `\u`/`\U` escapes.

examples.title: Round-trip quoted text

zh.purpose: 移除双引号并还原本实现支持的转义，适合读取由 `quote` 产生的文本。

params.s: 包含首尾双引号的完整文本。

zh.returns: 去除双引号并还原转义后的字符串。
notes: 支持 `\n`、`\t`、`\r`、`\\`、`\"` 和 `\xHH`；当前实现不解析 `\uXXXX` 或 `\UXXXXXXXX`。
errors: 缺少双引号抛出 `strconv: invalid quoted string`；不支持或不完整的转义抛出 `strconv: invalid escape`。

en.purpose: Remove double quotes and decode supported escapes, for example text produced by `quote`.

params.s: Complete text including opening and closing double quotes.

en.returns: The decoded string without the surrounding double quotes.
notes: Supports `\n`, `\t`, `\r`, `\\`, `\"` and `\xHH`; this implementation does not decode `\uXXXX` or `\UXXXXXXXX`.
errors: Missing double quotes throw `strconv: invalid quoted string`; unsupported or incomplete escapes throw `strconv: invalid escape`.

zh.purpose: 把文本按 Unicode 字符转为只含 ASCII 的双引号表示，便于在只接受 ASCII 的场景中展示。

params.s: 要处理的原文本；以只读借用传入，本调用不会修改它。

zh.returns: 带引号的 ASCII 文本；非 ASCII 字符使用 `\u` 或 `\U`，无效 UTF-8 字节使用 `\xHH`。
notes: 当前 `unquote` 不支持 `\u`/`\U`；需要在本包内往返转换时使用 `quote`。

en.purpose: Represent Unicode text as an ASCII-only double-quoted string.

params.s: Original text, passed as a read-only borrow; this call does not modify it.

en.returns: Quoted ASCII text, using `\u` or `\U` for non-ASCII characters and `\xHH` for invalid UTF-8 bytes.
notes: The current `unquote` does not support `\u`/`\U`; use `quote` for round trips within this package.

zh.purpose: 把一个 Unicode 码点转换为带单引号的字符表示。

params.r: Unicode 码点；无效标量值会替换为 U+FFFD。

zh.returns: 带单引号的字符文本；可显示的非 ASCII 字符保留为 UTF-8，控制字符使用转义。

en.purpose: Represent a Unicode code point as a single-quoted character literal.

params.r: Unicode code point; an invalid scalar is replaced with U+FFFD.

en.returns: Single-quoted character text; printable non-ASCII characters remain UTF-8 and control characters use escapes.

zh.purpose: 把一个 Unicode 码点转换为带单引号的字符表示。

params.r: Unicode 码点；无效标量值会替换为 U+FFFD。

zh.returns: 带单引号的字符文本；非 ASCII 字符使用转义。

en.purpose: Represent a Unicode code point as a single-quoted character literal.

params.r: Unicode code point; an invalid scalar is replaced with U+FFFD.

en.returns: Single-quoted character text; non-ASCII characters use escapes.

zh.purpose: 从一段文本开头取出完整的引号片段，保留引号，方便再处理后面的内容。

params.s: 必须以双引号或单引号开头的文本。

zh.returns: 截至第一个未转义的同类结束引号的前缀，包括首尾引号。
notes: 只查找引号边界，不解码或完整校验片段里的转义。
errors: 未以引号开头、缺少结束引号或末尾反斜杠不完整时抛出 `strconv: invalid quoted prefix`。

en.purpose: Extract a complete quoted prefix, retaining its quotes for processing text that follows.

params.s: Text beginning with a double or single quote.

en.returns: Prefix through the first unescaped matching closing quote, including both quotes.
notes: This finds quote boundaries without decoding or fully validating escapes.
errors: Missing opening or closing quotes, or an incomplete trailing backslash, throw `strconv: invalid quoted prefix`.

zh.purpose: 检查文本是否可以直接放在反引号中，适合决定日志或源码展示的引用形式。

params.s: 要处理的原文本；以只读借用传入，本调用不会修改它。

zh.returns: 不含反引号、ASCII 控制字节或 DEL 时为 `true`；空文本为 `true`。
notes: 制表符和换行也属于拒绝的控制字节。

en.purpose: Check whether text can be placed directly inside backquotes.

params.s: Original text, passed as a read-only borrow; this call does not modify it.

en.returns: `true` when there are no backquotes, ASCII control bytes or DEL; empty text returns `true`.
notes: Tabs and newlines are among the rejected control bytes.

zh.purpose: 处理按钮的按下、释放和键盘激活，只有一次完整的激活才触发业务动作。

params.input: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 在按钮内按下并在内部释放，或聚焦后按下并释放 Enter/空格，产生 `ACTION_ACTIVATE`；只读状态不会激活。

en.purpose: Process button presses, releases and keyboard activation; perform the business action on a completed activation.

params.input: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: Pressing and releasing inside, or pressing and releasing Enter/Space while focused, yields `ACTION_ACTIVATE`; read-only buttons do not activate.

zh.purpose: 处理复选框交互，并在用户激活时更新勾选状态。

params.input: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 改变时返回 `ACTION_CHANGE`，`value` 为 `1.0`（勾选）或 `0.0`（未勾选）；不确定状态首次激活后变为勾选。

en.purpose: Process checkbox interaction and update its checked state when activated.

params.input: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: A change yields `ACTION_CHANGE`, with `value` `1.0` for checked or `0.0` for unchecked; activating an indeterminate box checks it.

zh.purpose: 处理可输入下拉框的菜单选择、展开按钮和编辑器输入。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 选中菜单项时返回 `ACTION_CHANGE`，`value` 为原选项列表中的索引；输入法组合期间把 Enter/方向键留给编辑器。

en.purpose: Process editable combo-box choice selection, its toggle and editor input.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: Choosing an item yields `ACTION_CHANGE` with its original option index in `value`; Enter and arrows remain with the editor during IME composition.

zh.purpose: 处理展开、多项勾选和已选标签交互，把用户选择写回控件状态。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 选项切换返回 `ACTION_CHANGE`，`value` 为发生变化的选项索引；读取 `selected(index)` 获取该项现在的勾选状态。

en.purpose: Process opening, multiple selection and selected-chip interaction, updating control state.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: Toggling an option yields `ACTION_CHANGE` with the changed option index; call `selected(index)` for its new checked state.

zh.purpose: 处理拖动和键盘调节，在连续变化和最终提交之间区分动作类型。

params.input: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: `ACTION_CHANGE` 表示连续变化，`ACTION_COMMIT` 表示一次已改变数值的交互完成；`value` 是当前数值。启用 `set_commit_only` 后不发送连续变化。

en.purpose: Handle dragging and keyboard adjustments, distinguishing live changes from a final commit.

params.input: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: `ACTION_CHANGE` reports live changes; `ACTION_COMMIT` completes an interaction that changed the value. `value` is current; `set_commit_only` suppresses live change actions.

zh.purpose: 把输入交给当前 RGBA 通道，更新颜色并返回颜色变化或提交动作。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 聚焦时用上/下方向键切换通道；`Action.value` 是打包颜色的数值，读取 `value()` 可得到 `draw.Color`。

en.purpose: Route input to the active RGBA channel and report color changes or commits.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: While focused, Up/Down switches channels; `Action.value` contains the packed color number, and `value()` returns a `draw.Color`.

zh.purpose: 处理弹出层的外部点击、Escape 和取消输入，按关闭策略更新打开状态。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 锚点和面板内部的点击不会作为外部点击关闭；面板内容的业务交互由调用方继续分发。

en.purpose: Handle outside presses, Escape and cancellation according to the popover's dismissal settings.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: Presses inside the anchor or panel are not outside dismissal; the caller continues dispatching interactions to panel content.

zh.purpose: 先处理模态层的关闭和 Tab 焦点循环，再决定是否把输入交给面板内容。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 先于背景控件分发；用 `allows_content` 判断内容输入。退出动画尚未结束时仍阻止背景交互。

en.purpose: Handle modal dismissal and Tab focus cycling before deciding whether content can receive input.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: Dispatch before background controls and use `allows_content` for content input. The modal continues blocking background input during its exit animation.

zh.purpose: 控制下拉选项列表的打开状态。

params.open: `true` 请求打开，`false` 关闭；禁用或只读时请求打开也会保持关闭。

zh.returns: 不返回值；更新后的状态可用 `is_open()` 读取。
notes: 打开状态与绘制是两步：还需在合适的覆盖层调用 `paint_popup_styled`。
显式打开时先展示全部选项；随后编辑文字才按输入过滤。

en.purpose: Set whether the option list is open.

params.open: `true` requests opening and `false` closes it; disabled or read-only controls remain closed.

en.returns: No return value; read the resulting state with `is_open()`.
notes: Opening and painting are separate: call `paint_popup_styled` in an appropriate overlay pass.
An explicit open shows all options; subsequent editing filters them.

zh.purpose: 绘制展开的选项列表；与输入框本体分开绘制，以便选项覆盖后面的控件。

params.frame: 当前绘制帧；本调用向其中记录绘制命令。
params.styles: 当前生效的样式；提供颜色、间距、字体和状态外观。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 在画布坐标空间中绘制，通常放在普通控件之后；不要沿用输入框内部的局部变换或裁剪，否则列表可能被截掉。
errors: 绘制帧、文字或样式操作失败时继续抛出错误。

en.purpose: Paint the expanded option list separately from the field so it can appear above other controls.

params.frame: Current frame to receive drawing commands.
params.styles: Effective styles supplying colors, spacing, fonts and state appearance.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: Paint in canvas coordinates, normally after regular controls. A field-local transform or clip can shift or cut off the list.
errors: Frame, text or style failures propagate as errors.

zh.purpose: 读取下拉列表在画布中的矩形，用于覆盖层命中测试或布局判断。
zh.returns: 弹出列表的 `layout.Rect`；读取矩形不会打开列表，应同时检查 `is_open()`。

en.purpose: Read the option-list rectangle in canvas coordinates for overlay hit testing or layout.
en.returns: The list's `layout.Rect`; reading it does not open the list, so also check `is_open()`.

zh.purpose: 接收窗口原生事件；输入事件转交 `input`，其余事件交给内部编辑器或基础控件处理。

params.event: 窗口提供的完整 `ui.Event`；需要输入法、失焦和生命周期处理时使用这个入口。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 内部失去焦点后会关闭下拉列表。

en.purpose: Receive native window events, routing input to `input` and other events to the internal editor or base control.

params.event: Full native `ui.Event`; use this entry point for IME, blur and lifecycle handling.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: The option list closes when its internal control loses focus.

zh.purpose: 控制下拉选项列表的打开状态。

params.open: `true` 请求打开，`false` 关闭；禁用或只读时请求打开也会保持关闭。

zh.returns: 不返回值；更新后的状态可用 `is_open()` 读取。
notes: 打开状态与绘制是两步：还需在合适的覆盖层调用 `paint_popup_styled`。

en.purpose: Set whether the option list is open.

params.open: `true` requests opening and `false` closes it; disabled or read-only controls remain closed.

en.returns: No return value; read the resulting state with `is_open()`.
notes: Opening and painting are separate: call `paint_popup_styled` in an appropriate overlay pass.

zh.purpose: 绘制展开的选项列表；与输入框本体分开绘制，以便选项覆盖后面的控件。

params.frame: 当前绘制帧；本调用向其中记录绘制命令。
params.styles: 当前生效的样式；提供颜色、间距、字体和状态外观。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 在画布坐标空间中绘制，通常放在普通控件之后；不要沿用输入框内部的局部变换或裁剪，否则列表可能被截掉。
errors: 绘制帧、文字或样式操作失败时继续抛出错误。

en.purpose: Paint the expanded option list separately from the field so it can appear above other controls.

params.frame: Current frame to receive drawing commands.
params.styles: Effective styles supplying colors, spacing, fonts and state appearance.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: Paint in canvas coordinates, normally after regular controls. A field-local transform or clip can shift or cut off the list.
errors: Frame, text or style failures propagate as errors.

zh.purpose: 读取下拉列表在画布中的矩形，用于覆盖层命中测试或布局判断。
zh.returns: 弹出列表的 `layout.Rect`；读取矩形不会打开列表，应同时检查 `is_open()`。

en.purpose: Read the option-list rectangle in canvas coordinates for overlay hit testing or layout.
en.returns: The list's `layout.Rect`; reading it does not open the list, so also check `is_open()`.

zh.purpose: 接收窗口原生事件；输入事件转交 `input`，其余事件交给内部编辑器或基础控件处理。

params.event: 窗口提供的完整 `ui.Event`；需要输入法、失焦和生命周期处理时使用这个入口。

zh.returns: `Action` 描述本次交互：`kind` 是动作类型，`consumed` 表示事件是否已处理，`request_focus` 请求焦点，`needs_paint` 表示需要重绘。
notes: 内部失去焦点后会关闭下拉列表。

en.purpose: Receive native window events, routing input to `input` and other events to the internal editor or base control.

params.event: Full native `ui.Event`; use this entry point for IME, blur and lifecycle handling.

en.returns: An `Action`: `kind` identifies the action, `consumed` marks a handled event, `request_focus` requests focus, and `needs_paint` requests repainting.
notes: The option list closes when its internal control loses focus.

zh.purpose: 选择下拉框中的一个已有选项，把该选项文字写入编辑器并关闭菜单。

params.index: 原选项列表中从 `0` 开始的索引；不是过滤后的可见行号。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: 索引越界抛出 `widgets: combo choice out of range`；编辑器处于输入法组合状态时，替换文字也可能抛错。

en.purpose: Select an existing choice, copy its text into the editor and close the list.

params.index: Zero-based index in the original options, not the filtered visible row.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: An invalid index throws `widgets: combo choice out of range`; replacing text during IME composition can also throw.

zh.purpose: 读取当前文字匹配的原选项索引，适合检查输入是否对应已有选项。
zh.returns: 匹配选项的索引；文字不匹配任何选项时为 `-1`。

en.purpose: Read the original option index matching the current text, to check whether it corresponds to an existing choice.
en.returns: Original matching option index, or `-1` when the text matches no option.

zh.purpose: 以程序方式更新可输入下拉框的文字，并刷新内部查询状态。

params.value: 新的完整文字；与已有选项完全一致时会更新匹配索引。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: 编辑器拒绝替换（例如输入法组合尚未完成）时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Programmatically replace editable combo-box text and refresh its query state.

params.value: Complete new text; an exact option match updates the matching index.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: An editor replacement failure, such as active IME composition, propagates.

zh.purpose: 设置某一选项是否勾选，不改变其他选项，适合回填表单中的多选结果。

params.index: 原选项列表中从 `0` 开始的索引。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: 控件已释放或索引不在 `0..count()-1` 时抛错。

en.purpose: Set one option's checked state without changing other choices, for example when restoring form data.

params.index: Zero-based index in the original option list.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: A disposed control or index outside `0..count()-1` throws.

zh.purpose: 检查某一选项当前是否勾选，适合在变化动作后读取最终状态。

params.index: 原选项列表中从 `0` 开始的索引。

zh.returns: 勾选时为 `true`，否则为 `false`。
errors: 索引越界抛出 `widgets: choice index out of range`。

en.purpose: Check whether one option is selected, for example after receiving a change action.

params.index: Zero-based index in the original option list.

en.returns: `true` if checked, otherwise `false`.
errors: An invalid index throws `widgets: choice index out of range`.

zh.purpose: 设置复选框的勾选状态，并清除不确定状态，适合用业务数据更新控件。
zh.returns: 不返回值；状态改变时会标记需要重绘，不生成用户输入动作。

en.purpose: Set a checkbox's checked state and clear indeterminate state from application data.
en.returns: No return value; a state change marks repainting without generating a user input action.

zh.purpose: 设置按钮的持续选中外观，适合工具栏模式开关；选中与短暂按下是不同状态。

params.selected: 是否显示为选中；这不会模拟一次点击或发出激活动作。

zh.returns: 不返回值；状态改变时标记需要重绘。

en.purpose: Set a button's persistent selected appearance, for example a toolbar mode toggle.

params.selected: Whether to display selection; this does not simulate a click or emit activation.

en.returns: No return value; changed state marks repainting.

zh.purpose: 设置滑块数值，按已配置范围和步长约束结果。

params.value: 有限浮点数；超出范围会被限制到端点，并按步长对齐。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: `NaN` 或无穷值抛出 `widgets: invalid slider value`。

en.purpose: Set a slider value, constrained by its configured range and step.

params.value: Finite value; it is clamped to the range and snapped to the configured step.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: `NaN` or infinity throws `widgets: invalid slider value`.

zh.purpose: 选择只在一次调节结束时发出提交动作，适合变化处理较昂贵的业务。

params.enabled: 为 `true` 时抑制拖动中的 `ACTION_CHANGE`，保留结束时的 `ACTION_COMMIT`。

zh.returns: 不返回值；设置时会清除当前待提交标记。
notes: 拖动时控件内部数值仍更新并重绘；调用方把昂贵操作放到提交动作中处理。

en.purpose: Emit only final commit actions when applying changes is expensive.

params.enabled: `true` suppresses live `ACTION_CHANGE` while retaining the final `ACTION_COMMIT`.

en.returns: No return value; setting this clears the current pending-commit flag.
notes: The displayed value still updates during dragging; apply expensive work when handling the commit action.

zh.purpose: 更新一个 RGBA 通道，适合从数值输入框单独调整颜色分量。

params.value: 通道强度 `0..255`；透明度 `0` 全透明、`255` 不透明。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: 控件已释放、通道编号或数值越界时抛错；这里不会静默截断到有效范围。

en.purpose: Update one RGBA channel, for example from a numeric field.

params.value: Channel intensity `0..255`; alpha `0` is transparent and `255` is opaque.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: A disposed control, invalid channel or out-of-range value throws instead of silently clamping.

zh.purpose: 一次设置 RGBA 颜色，并同步四个通道滑块。
zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
errors: 任一通道更新失败时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Set an RGBA color and synchronize all four channel sliders.
en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
errors: A channel update failure propagates.

zh.purpose: 读取当前四个通道组成的颜色，供绘制或保存。
zh.returns: 包含红、绿、蓝和透明度的 `draw.Color`。

en.purpose: Read the color assembled from the four current channels for painting or storage.
en.returns: A `draw.Color` with red, green, blue and alpha.

zh.purpose: 打开弹出层并启动入场动画；禁用的弹出层保持关闭。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 每帧调用 `tick` 推进动画，用 `is_visible` 决定是否继续绘制。
errors: 动画参数或状态无效时抛错。

en.purpose: Open the popover with its entrance animation; a disabled popover stays closed.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: Advance animation with `tick` each frame and use `is_visible` to decide whether painting must continue.
errors: Invalid animation parameters or state throw.

zh.purpose: 请求关闭并启动退场动画；逻辑关闭之后可能还需要继续绘制几帧。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: `is_open()` 随关闭请求变为 `false`，`is_visible()` 在退场动画结束后才变为 `false`。
errors: 动画操作失败时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Request closing with an exit animation; painting may continue briefly after logical closure.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: `is_open()` becomes false on the close request; `is_visible()` becomes false after the exit animation ends.
errors: Animation failures propagate.

zh.purpose: 把淡入淡出动画推进到当前时间，用返回值决定是否安排重绘。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。

zh.returns: 透明度发生变化时返回 `true`；没有变化返回 `false`。
errors: 时间或动画状态无效时抛错。

en.purpose: Advance the fade animation to the current time and use the result to schedule repainting.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.

en.returns: `true` when opacity changes, otherwise `false`.
errors: Invalid time or animation state throws.

zh.purpose: 判断弹出层是否仍需要绘制，包括正在退场的阶段。
zh.returns: 打开或仍有退场透明度时为 `true`；完全消失后为 `false`。

en.purpose: Check whether the popover remains visible, including its exit transition.
en.returns: `true` while open or fading out, and `false` once fully hidden.

zh.purpose: 绘制弹出面板的样式背景与边框。

params.frame: 当前绘制帧；本调用向其中记录绘制命令。
params.styles: 当前生效的样式；提供颜色、间距、字体和状态外观。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 面板内容由调用方绘制；本调用不会自动创建、布局或分发内容控件。
errors: 绘制命令失败时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Paint the popover panel background and border.

params.frame: Current frame to receive drawing commands.
params.styles: Effective styles supplying colors, spacing, fonts and state appearance.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: The caller paints panel content; this call does not create, lay out or dispatch content controls.
errors: Drawing failures propagate.

zh.purpose: 打开模态层并记录关闭后的焦点恢复目标。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。
params.restore_focus: 关闭完成后需要恢复的控件 ID；`0` 表示没有恢复目标，不能为负数。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 每帧调用 `tick` 推进动画，用 `is_visible` 决定是否继续绘制。
errors: 动画参数或状态无效时抛错。焦点恢复 ID 为负数也会抛错。

en.purpose: Open the modal and remember the focus restoration target.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.
params.restore_focus: Control ID to restore after closing; `0` means no target and negative values are invalid.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: Advance animation with `tick` each frame and use `is_visible` to decide whether painting must continue.
errors: Invalid animation parameters or state throw. A negative focus restoration ID also throws.

zh.purpose: 请求关闭并启动退场动画；逻辑关闭之后可能还需要继续绘制几帧。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: `is_open()` 随关闭请求变为 `false`，`is_visible()` 在退场动画结束后才变为 `false`。
errors: 动画操作失败时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Request closing with an exit animation; painting may continue briefly after logical closure.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: `is_open()` becomes false on the close request; `is_visible()` becomes false after the exit animation ends.
errors: Animation failures propagate.

zh.purpose: 把淡入淡出动画推进到当前时间，用返回值决定是否安排重绘。

params.now: 当前动画时间 `time.Instant`；打开、更新和关闭应使用同一时间基准。
params.reduced_motion: 是否减少动态效果；为 `true` 时直接到目标状态。

zh.returns: 透明度发生变化时返回 `true`；没有变化返回 `false`。
errors: 时间或动画状态无效时抛错。

en.purpose: Advance the fade animation to the current time and use the result to schedule repainting.

params.now: Current animation `time.Instant`; use the same time basis for opening, ticking and closing.
params.reduced_motion: Whether to reduce motion; `true` moves directly to the target state.

en.returns: `true` when opacity changes, otherwise `false`.
errors: Invalid time or animation state throws.

zh.purpose: 判断模态层是否仍需要绘制，包括正在退场的阶段。
zh.returns: 打开或仍有退场透明度时为 `true`；完全消失后为 `false`。

en.purpose: Check whether the modal remains visible, including its exit transition.
en.returns: `true` while open or fading out, and `false` once fully hidden.

zh.purpose: 绘制模态遮罩、面板和关闭按钮。

params.frame: 当前绘制帧；本调用向其中记录绘制命令。
params.styles: 当前生效的样式；提供颜色、间距、字体和状态外观。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 面板内容由调用方绘制；本调用不会自动创建、布局或分发内容控件。
errors: 绘制命令失败时继续抛错。

en.purpose: Paint the modal backdrop, panel and close button.

params.frame: Current frame to receive drawing commands.
params.styles: Effective styles supplying colors, spacing, fonts and state appearance.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: The caller paints panel content; this call does not create, lay out or dispatch content controls.
errors: Drawing failures propagate.

zh.purpose: 设置模态层内部的 Tab 遍历顺序，让键盘焦点在指定控件中循环。

params.ids: 内容控件 ID 的有序列表，最多 `256` 项；ID 必须为正数、不能重复，也不能等于模态层自身 ID。

zh.returns: 成功返回 `0`；失败时抛错，不以非零返回码表示失败。
notes: 原焦点仍在新列表中时保留它，否则选第一项；空列表表示没有内容焦点目标。
errors: 数量、ID 或重复校验失败时抛错。

en.purpose: Set the modal's Tab traversal order so keyboard focus cycles through the specified controls.

params.ids: Ordered content control IDs, at most `256`; IDs must be positive, unique and different from the modal's own ID.

en.returns: Returns `0` on success; failure throws rather than returning a nonzero status.
notes: Retain the old focus when listed, otherwise select the first target; an empty list has no content focus target.
errors: An invalid count, ID or duplicate throws.

zh.purpose: 在模态层完全关闭后，取出一次性的焦点恢复目标并交给窗口焦点逻辑处理。
zh.returns: 待恢复的控件 ID；仍可见或没有待处理恢复请求时返回 `0`。同一请求只取一次。

en.purpose: Consume the one-time focus restoration target once the modal is fully hidden.
en.returns: Control ID to restore, or `0` while visible or without a pending request. Each request is consumed once.

zh.purpose: 判断当前输入能否交给模态面板内部的控件，用于模态层优先分发后的下一步。

params.event: 同一窗口、画布和代次的输入事件；坐标按控件所在的画布空间传入。

zh.returns: 允许时为 `true`；未打开、身份不匹配、Tab/Escape 或落在关闭按钮上的输入为 `false`。
notes: 键盘输入还要求存在内容焦点目标；指针输入需要落在面板内。

en.purpose: Decide whether input may reach modal content after modal-first dispatch.

params.event: Input event for the same window, canvas and generation, with coordinates in the control's canvas space.

en.returns: `true` when allowed; false when closed, mismatched, handling Tab/Escape, or hitting the close button.
notes: Keyboard input also requires a content focus target; pointer input must be inside the panel.
